title: El Grito Celebration 2026
description:
Los Ángeles Azules will headline El Grito Los Angeles 2026, bringing an evening of music, culture and community to the Spring Street steps of Los Angeles City Hall.

Presented by Councilmember Imelda Padilla and hosted by comedian Concrete, the free celebration will also feature performances by Trish Toledo and Estrada, along with cultural programming, community partners and the traditional bell-ringing ceremony commemorating Mexico’s call for independence.

El Grito marks the beginning of Latino Heritage Month in Los Angeles and brings generations of Angelenos together to celebrate Mexican culture, history and community pride.


📅 Tuesday, September 15
⏰ 5–10 PM
📍 Los Angeles City Hall
🎟️ FREE & OPEN TO THE PUBLIC
